package.name: hexa_locomotion
package.description: Consolidated single-node locomotion controller. Compiles the target-agnostic control brain (shared/hexa_pipeline) directly and runs the whole velocity-shaping -> gait -> posture -> compose/IK pipeline in one 200 Hz tick, mirroring the Pi Pico firmware's single loop but with ROS seams: /cmd_vel + the discrete command topics in, joint commands out. Replaces the control_node -> gait_node -> posture_node -> ik_node -> joint_command_bridge process chain; the geometry+tuning config is loaded from geometry.yaml / tuning.yaml at startup (PipelineConfig), so runtime tuning is preserved.
